OMV Petrom is the largest energy company in South-Eastern Europe, being active on every aspect of the energy value chain: from wells, producing oil and gas, to refining and fuels distribution, gas supply and power generation & supply. We provide the energy for day-to-day modern life: fuels for mobility, light and heat. We believe that we can only evolve with a diverse mix of employees and by ensuring a healthy work-life balance.
Our Business | OMVPetrom.com
At OMV Petrom, we have a long tradition of responsible behavior towards employees, the environment and society. Sustainability means a focus on conducting the business responsibly, efficiently and in an innovative way. We are committed to create long-term value for the company and our stakeholders, while respecting the environment and, supporting the communities in which we operate.
Sustainability | OMVPetrom.com
 Your tasks
Business analyze for all IT requirements of the production teams, in line with the digital development plan of the Petrobrazi Refinery.
Facilitating collaboration between the 3 refineries of the OMV Group regarding the digitalization portfolio and IT optimization.
Consulting the team responsible for the digital development plan on the appropriate implementation approach and ensuring the successful operationalization of digital priorities.
Supporting Enterprise Architecture in identifying the most suitable solutions aligned with the company strategy.
Managing requests and projects closely linked to process optimization at the IT–OT interface, applying both waterfall and agile methods.
Managing the application ecosystem and their connections using interfaces in the production area.
Planning and monitoring the budget for existing and new applications (IT demand).
Coordinating stakeholder and requirements management to address current needs, ensuring fit-for-purpose solutions in line with defined IT guidelines and business KPIs.
Coordinating IT/OT security topics in production according to OMV guidelines and business best practices for current and future applications.
Identifying, selecting, and coordinating suppliers for new projects and existing services. Ensuring IT requirements and technical evaluations within tendering and procurement processes, in close alignment with Procurement and business stakeholders.
Responsible for data and application management, with a focus on continuous service improvement.
 Your profile
University degree Master - Project Management, Information technology, Information security
Excellent knowledge of English language
Experience in Project Management, Information technology, Information security, business administration, or comparable professional experience: > 7 years.
 Excellent knowledge of IT & OT systems

Coding experience
Excellent understanding of IT Application and Project Management
Experience in the Energy Sector
